name: Duck Mountain Provincial Park - Fern Campground
waterfront_evidence: Split 2026-11-19. Every Fern paging row reads 'Near Water - no'. Esri World_Imagery z17 (0.74 m/px) and z18 (0.37 m/px) with all 21 SKPP GIS points (F1-F19, yurts Y1-Y2): the loop runs along Madge Lake's south shore behind a continuous band of spruce; water-mask distances from the sites to the lake edge F8 11 m, F7 17 m, F10 20 m, F4 and F12 28 m, F3 30 m, F1 32 m, F2 38 m, the rest 41-98 m. SKPP site photos (read 2026-11-19): the lake shows through the trees from F2, F7, F8 and F10 (perhaps F9 and F12); no site on open ground to the water. The view rests on F2 (32 ft), F8 and F10 (25 ft); F7 takes 18 ft only and F12 a tent only. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: ReserveAmerica SKPP parkId 290275, Fern loop, read 2026-11-19 (paging table + every site's detail page): 19 site-specific sites F1-F19, 2 Nightly Electric (F1, F2, 15/30 A) and 17 Nightly Non-Electric, all Back-In, plus Camp-Easy yurts Y1-Y2 (not counted). 'Allowed Equipment' takes a unit of 26-32 ft on F1-F3 and 19-25 ft on F8, F10, F11, F13-F15, F17 and F18, up to 18 ft on F6, F7, F9, F16 and F19, and a tent only on F4, F5 and F12, so 11 nightly sites fit a 23-ft rig. Park map (2026-04-10) draws Fern on Madge Lake's south shore by Highway 57 and the park village; its own access road meets Highway 57 450 m away (OSRM), 5.9 km by road from Pickerel Point. Runs the park's winter camping. A real public drive-in RV campground a 23-ft rig fits. --Claude
note: The park's small lakeshore loop by the park village on Highway 57, about 2 km southwest of the Pickerel Point campground (own entry). Wooded sites: only F1 and F2 have power; online booking takes a unit of 19-25 ft on eight more, 18 ft or less on five, and a tent only on F4, F5 and F12. Two Camp-Easy yurts. --Claude

season.note: 2026-27 dates. Summer season May 14 to September 30; winter camping November 1 to March 14 with power at site 2 only, firewood and outhouses, no water, showers or dump station. October nights are booked through the park office.

fees.note: $4 a night less from October 1, with reduced services.
